description: Read merchant transactions, payouts, checkouts, sales, and card readers.

sumup_new_or_updated_sale_trigger.description: Runs for each sale added or changed in SumUp. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, user_id, currency.code, currency.scale, name, note, items, price.net_amount, price.gross_amount, price.cart_discounts, price.taxes, tax_mode, source.channel, source.sub_channel, source.external_id, source.external_sub_channel_id, payments, created_at, closed_at, state

sumup_new_or_updated_transaction_trigger.description: Runs for each transaction added or changed in SumUp. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, transaction_code, amount, currency, timestamp, status, payment_type, installments_count, entry_mode, product_summary, payouts_total, payouts_received, payout_plan, transaction_id, client_transaction_id, user, type, card_type, payout_date, payout_type, refunded_amount

sumup_new_sale_trigger.description: Runs for each new sale in SumUp. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, user_id, currency.code, currency.scale, name, note, items, price.net_amount, price.gross_amount, price.cart_discounts, price.taxes, tax_mode, source.channel, source.sub_channel, source.external_id, source.external_sub_channel_id, payments, created_at, closed_at, state

sumup_new_transaction_trigger.description: Runs for each new transaction in SumUp. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, transaction_code, amount, currency, timestamp, status, payment_type, installments_count, entry_mode, product_summary, payouts_total, payouts_received, payout_plan, transaction_id, client_transaction_id, user, type, card_type, payout_date, payout_type, refunded_amount
